clone.Name: clone
clone.description: Clones an environment to a new environment so that both have identical environment settings

--clone_name.Name: --clone_name
--clone_name.description: Desired name for the cloned environment

--cname.Name: --cname
--cname.description: Desired CNAME prefix for the cloned environment

--envvars.Name: --envvars
--envvars.description: Environment properties in a comma-separated list with the format name=value

--exact.Name: --exact
--exact.description: Prevents Elastic Beanstalk from updating the solution stack version for the new clone environment to the most recent version available

--scale.Name: --scale
--scale.description: The number of instances to run in the clone environment when it is launched

--tags.Name: --tags
--tags.description: Tags for the resources in your environment in a comma-separated list with the format name=value

--timeout.Name: --timeout
--timeout.description: The number of minutes before the command times out

-c.Name: -c
-c.description: Desired CNAME prefix for the cloned environment

-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Desired name for the cloned environment

ssh.Name: ssh
ssh.description: Connect to a Linux Amazon EC2 instance in your environment using Secure Shell

--command.description: Execute a shell command on the specified instance instead of starting an SSH session

--custom.description: Specify an SSH command to use instead of 'ssh -i keyfile'. Do not include the remote user and hostname

--force.description: Open port 22 to incoming traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 in the environment's security group, even if the security group is already configured for SSH

--instance.Name: --instance
--instance.description: The ID of the instance to connect to

--keep_open.Name: --keep_open
--keep_open.description: Leave port 22 open on the security group after the SSH session ends

--number.Name: --number
--number.description: The number of the instance to connect to by number

--setup.Name: --setup
--setup.description: Change the key pair assigned to the environment's instances

-i.description: The ID of the instance to connect to
